A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same SlideChat, SlideInstruction, and SlideBench work. Their main text, tables, figures, and complete appendices support reliable comparison despite substantial reformatting.

before.justification: v1 reports original captioning and VQA evaluations, model ablations, attention visualizations, and computational-cost measurements.

after.justification: v3 retains these original empirical results and adds evaluated Quilt-LLaVA comparisons.

M1.justification: The patch encoder, LongNet slide encoder, projector, LLM, and two-stage training procedure remain unchanged. Describing enhanced patch tokens instead of aggregated features clarifies the existing architecture without establishing a procedural change.

E1.justification: Both versions use the same ten TCGA datasets, BCNB, and WSI-VQA subset for the same captioning and pathology VQA tasks. Changed illustrative examples do not establish new evaluated coverage.

E2.justification: Quilt-LLaVA, previously discussed without evaluated results, is added with patch and thumbnail inputs to captioning and all three VQA comparisons, including supplementary breakdowns. Existing comparators are retained.

E3.justification: The splits, training counts, metrics, 30-patch and 1024-by-1024 thumbnail comparisons, and training budgets remain unchanged. v3 clarifies QA filtering and exclusion of training samples from WSI-VQA*, without establishing changed experimental settings.

E4.justification: The LLM and model-size comparisons, slide-encoder ablation, attention analysis, and substantive case studies in Figures 5 and 7–9 are retained. Computational-cost analysis moves from the main text to Section 7.1 without new measurements.

E5.justification: Neither version reports seeds, repeated-run counts, confidence intervals, error bars, or significance tests. The added results use the existing point-estimate reporting practice.

E6.justification: v3 adds Quilt-LLaVA scores while retaining matched SlideChat results and ablations. The main BCNB advantage changes from 12.71 to 12.59 points, and MedDr's patch/thumbnail trend description is corrected. However, Quilt-LLaVA's BCNB patch accuracy is 32.19 in Table 2 versus 44.43 in the supplementary table; the supplement also retains the old 12.71-point margin.

T1.justification: Neither version develops formal assumptions, theorems, proofs, or mathematical derivations. The architecture and attention-extraction explanations introduce no changed formal reasoning.

C1.justification: The first-assistant, dataset, benchmark, and 18-of-22-task claims remain. The introduction revises the claimed BCNB advantage from 12.71 to 12.59 points, while the abstract and contribution bullets change promised release to reported public availability.

C2.justification: Interpretations concerning local/global context, cross-domain alignment, attention, and generalization remain. The supplementary discussion retains the same weaknesses in HER2 expression, histological grading, and molecular-subtype classification.

D1.justification: v3 adds a concrete project link reporting code, data, and model availability, and explicitly describes excluding QA pairs lacking category information. Training details and prompts are retained. Removing v1 Table 1 also removes its explicit count of 732 TCGA VQA patients.

R1.justification: v3 adds Hosseini et al.'s computational-pathology survey, Lu et al.'s cancer-origin work, and Zhou and Chen's survival-analysis work. It removes the introduction's separate closed-resource challenge while retaining the central positioning against patch/ROI-focused assistants.

P1.justification: Most prose and the main section sequence remain. v3 makes localized language and terminology edits, reorders contribution bullets and supplementary data statistics, relocates computational-cost discussion, and updates authorship and acknowledgements.

P2.justification: The document switches extensively from single-column to two-column presentation. Figures 1–3 are reworked, Figure 4 adds Quilt-LLaVA curves and changes its legend layout, comparison tables gain rows, the benchmark-summary table disappears, and supplementary tables and showcase figures are substantially rearranged.

improvement.justification: Adding a relevant pathology-specific comparator and clearer curation and resource-access documentation provides a limited overall benefit while preserving the original evidence. That benefit is constrained by inconsistent new BCNB scores—32.19 in Table 2 versus 44.43 in the supplement—and uncorrected supplementary margins. The revision improves comparison breadth and documentation, but does not provide a clean quantitative account of the added baseline.
